Private bookkeeping tools for Mojility Inc. The current release reads QuickBooks customer records and manages the connection. Estimate and invoice creation is planned. Payment processing is outside this tool's scope.

The bookkeeping commands run on the owner's Mac. This AWS service handles authorization, token refresh and disconnection.

Questions or problems: info@mojility.ca.
/privacy:
Mojility Inc. operates this private application for its own bookkeeping. It is available only to authorized Mojility operators. Privacy contact: info@mojility.ca.

The local CLI uses QuickBooks company identifiers and customer information, including names, contact details and balances, for bookkeeping. QuickBooks remains the accounting source of truth. The AWS broker handles authorization codes and tokens; it does not request customer records from QuickBooks.

Tokens are stored in macOS Keychain. Intuit app credentials are stored in AWS Secrets Manager. The broker runs in AWS ca-central-1, Canada, and temporarily stores login sessions and tokens in an encrypted DynamoDB table. Connections use HTTPS.

Login sessions expire after 10 minutes. Collected sessions are removed from the broker. Expired sessions are unusable, but their physical removal by DynamoDB TTL can occur later. Local authorization tokens remain until replaced or removed. QuickBooks accounting records are not deleted when this app disconnects. Files or reports deliberately saved by an operator have their own retention.

Authorized AI-assisted bookkeeping uses OpenAI Codex to review selected information and prepare proposed work for the owner. The owner has disabled ChatGPT model training and Codex environment training. QuickBooks data must not be used to train models or to benefit unrelated customers. The application does not sell accounting data. AWS, Intuit and OpenAI process information under their applicable service terms.

Application responses and error handling exclude token values and raw customer payloads from diagnostic logs. AWS retains service diagnostics under its logging configuration. These public pages do not set tracking cookies or load advertising or analytics scripts.

Run qbo auth disconnect to revoke the connection and remove local credentials. If it fails, credentials remain available for a retry. Alternatively, disconnect the app through QuickBooks Connected Apps. Local qbo auth logout removes local credentials only; it does not revoke Intuit access. Contact info@mojility.ca for assistance or a request concerning application-held data.
/terms:
This application is operated by Mojility Inc. for authorized internal bookkeeping use. It is not a public bookkeeping service. Support contact: info@mojility.ca.

The current release supports customer lookup and QuickBooks connection management. It does not process payments, file taxes or provide financial, tax or legal advice. Estimate and invoice creation is planned and is not enabled in this release.

Operators must check results against QuickBooks before relying on them. Future accounting changes and document sending require the owner's explicit instruction and review of the proposed details. AI-generated descriptions or recommendations can contain errors.

Use is subject to the applicable Intuit service terms and, when AI assistance is used, the applicable OpenAI service terms. These terms do not replace those providers' agreements or grant access to another company's accounting records.

The source code is available under the MIT license. That license governs the software's distribution and warranty terms. Access to Mojility's private credentials and accounting data is not granted by the source-code license. Disconnect instructions and data handling are described on this site's Disconnect and Privacy pages.
/connect:
Start the connection from the CLI on the owner's Mac. For the sandbox, run qbo auth login --broker-url https://qbo-auth.mojility.ca --environment sandbox. Open the Intuit authorization link and select the test company.

The service is currently configured for sandbox testing. Production credentials, production callback registration and a separate owner authorization are required before live use.

After authorization, the CLI receives the connection tokens and stores them in macOS Keychain. Use qbo auth status to inspect the connection, then qbo customer list for a read-only check. Reconnect using the same login command if the connection expires or is revoked.

Support: info@mojility.ca.
/disconnect:
Run qbo auth disconnect on the connected Mac. It revokes the Intuit connection before removing local credentials. A failed revocation retains the credentials so that you can retry.

You can also disconnect this app in QuickBooks Connected Apps. If local tokens are unavailable, use QuickBooks to revoke access.

The qbo auth logout command removes local credentials only. It does not revoke Intuit access or delete accounting records.

Support: info@mojility.ca.
